rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - c4-outbound-prefix-strip-regex [ses_f0b3bb2bfffewFopk6tT2n61AZ].md:L6246] "The regex's narrowness is real (`clipboardHelpers.ts:74` vs `inject_image.rs:18`), but the hypothesized failure is unreachable on this path: every writer of `clipboard_history.image_data` stores bare base64 with no prefix (`event_handlers.rs:89,195`; `downloads_service.rs:287`; `telegram_service.rs:477`), so the regex is always a no-op and the payload always decodes.
